quest.title: Ahoy! A Pirate's Growth for Ye!
quest.description: Little Meng of Liyue Harbor seems to be perturbed of late...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: *sigh* Can I really do this?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong, Little Meng?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler. How do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You look kinda upset, Little Meng.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's the matter? Did the other kids stop playing that, uh, pirate game with you?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Eh? No, no. Little Lulu and Little Fei have just gone home, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I... wanted to have a little walk by myself, so I haven't gone back yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Won't your parents be worried?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: They should still be at work.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: But let's not talk about that right now. Can I ask you a question?

choices.text: And what might that question be?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: So... I've heard lots of people tell stories about you.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: You've been to so many places and you've seen so much, so perhaps you can give me an answer...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, you're getting all serious now. What's the question?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: So you're saying that people will mature naturally as they grow older?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: But wouldn't we mature too late, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, if you want to take a trip out of the city, we can accompany you!

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: That's... I wouldn't want to bother you. And I doubt that something special would fall into my lap just because I went outside the city...

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Instead, I'd like you to help me with something else.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: I've heard people say that if you have problems that you can't solve, you can write them down into a drifting bottle and let those troubles float down the river...

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: That way, they might actually be resolved.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: But I've also heard that there are lots of monsters outside. I don't think it would be safe to go alone.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: So, could you protect me while I do that?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Thanks a lot! Don't worry, I've got savings. I can pay you!

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Let's go, then. First, let's go down to the Bishui River.

choices.text: You need to have some special experiences.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Special experiences, huh... But I've never left Liyue Harbor in my life.

choices.text: I'm afraid I don't have time to play at the moment...

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Hahaha, I only play that game with Little Lulu and Little Fei. Since they're not around, the game is off for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Are we there yet? Hmm... We've got to pick a good spot to send our bottle off.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: We should find an upstream position if we want it to go out further...

talks.objective: Look for a place to release the drifting bottle

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Phew... I was up all night writing that message. If we'd lost the bottle, I'd have to write it all over again...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, an all-nighter? You sure have a lot of worries, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Well... not really? I just really want to know how I can become mature.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I've looked at lots of sources and read a ton of books, but the more I read, the less I understand...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Hehe, and that's why I wrote all the questions I don't understand into that message, in hopes that I'd get an answer.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: C'mon! Let's send our bottle off!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: This looks like a good spot. Let's put the bottle in the water here.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I hope I'll get my answers...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You will.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Thanks! Alright then, let's head back into the city.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, will Little Meng's questions really be resolved with a little bottle floating down the river?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps this is just his way of comforting himself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon feels like there's a lot he's not telling us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But come to think of it, this whole maturity thing is pretty tricky, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: What the... To think that these things existed... That was scary!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Thank you so much! C'mon, let's continue.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: ...Wait. Where's my drifting bottle? I was just holding onto it, but now it's gone!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Did I drop it while we were fighting that... that Whopperflower?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Please, help me find it!

talks.objective: Bring the drifting bottle back to Little Meng
Bring the drifting bottle back to Little Meng
Follow Little Meng to release the drifting bottle

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Hey there, Traveler! Have you found the drifting bottle yet?

talks.objective: Send Little Meng back to Liyue Harbor

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Thanks so much for today.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: This is for you. Please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Could you keep what happened today a secret from Little Lulu and Little Fei?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: This is a personal issue of mine. I don't want to drag their spirits down.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Okay then, I'm going home now. See you!

dialogues.speaker: Check
dialogues.text: Little Meng's drifting bottle didn't get very far. Perhaps it was filled with too many frustrations...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Where's that bottle gone off to...
